linkedin.text:
🚨 Your AI agent is guessing which security tool to use

Every time you drop an APK, ELF binary, or obfuscated JavaScript into Cursor or Claude Code, your agent tries random commands until something works. You waste twenty minutes on tool selection before the real analysis even starts.

reverse-skill is an AI security router that picks the right methodology and tool chain for any reverse engineering or pentesting target. Drop an Android APK and it routes to jadx and Frida. Drop firmware and it chains Ghidra with the right extraction scripts. Drop encrypted frontend JS and it loads the correct deobfuscation playbook.

✅ Routes 40+ security scenarios automatically
✅ Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cline
✅ Self-evolving knowledge base learns from every case

Over 20,000 developers and security researchers are already using it. The repo includes pre-built workflows for APK analysis, binary reverse engineering, malware triage, CTF challenges, and penetration testing.

Search "reverse-skill" on GitHub and clone it today. What security workflow are you automating next?
